description: Hop dong nghien cuu - thay doi ngan sach/co cau tai tro, them dieu kien nghiem thu, dao nguoc quyen so huu, them quyen su dung va tra thuong KH

changes.description: Tong ngan sach tang 10 ti len 12 ti; co cau tai tro thay doi (70/30 -> 60/40)
Them dieu kien kiem chung du lieu; them nguong chinh xac 90%; tang hoi dong len 7 nguoi co 2 chuyen gia quoc te
changes.old_text_hint: Hoi dong khoa hoc 5 thanh vien
changes.new_text_hint: 7 thanh vien bao gom 2 chuyen gia quoc te

changes.description: Dao nguoc quyen so huu: tu 'so huu chung theo ty le' sang 'so huu cua Ben A, Ben B duoc li-xang 5 nam'
changes.old_text_hint: so huu chung theo ty le tai tro
changes.new_text_hint: so huu cua Ben A, Ben B duoc cap quyen su dung

changes.description: Noi dung Dieu 5 thay doi hoan toan: tu 'tham quan co so' sang 'quyen su dung ket qua nghien cuu'
changes.old_text_hint: tham quan co so nghien cuu
changes.new_text_hint: li-xang doc quyen su dung ket qua

changes.description: Them moi dieu khoan tra thuong khi cong bo bai bao Q1/Q2 va bang sang che
Xoa noi dung cu cua Dieu 5 ve quyen tham quan co so nghien cuu
